8 اِفْتَصَعْتُ مِنْهُ حَقِّى I took from him my right, or due, (O, K, *) all of it, (K,) by force, (O, K,) not leaving of it anything: (O:) or I took from him my right, or due, all of it, on the spot. (S, O.) ―
-b2- See also 1, latter half.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
